mechanism: Tadalafil is a CYP3A4 substrate and atomoxetine is a CYP2D6 substrate with potential for additive cardiovascular effects (both affect blood pressure and heart rate); minimal direct CYP450 competition but shared pharmacodynamic cardiac effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; assess cardiovascular risk factors before co-prescribing; use lowest effective doses and counsel patient on orthostatic hypotension symptoms.
